The '''''Calitana''''' was a group of 2 [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|escort shuttles]] that was used by the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] during the [[Sepan Civil War]]. At [[Sepan 8]] they were part of the Ripoblus defence force for a transfer between the children's leaders of both the [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] and Ripoblus factions as part of a new treaty between the factions to set aside their differences and resist Imperial intervention and occupation. The Imperials however, learned of the meeting and [[Battle of Sepan 8|intercepted]] sending [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]], one of which was piloted by Imperial Ace [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], to disable both [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] [[Keydon]] and [[Phantele]] carrying the children, then sent [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transports]] to board them and take the leaders to the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory I-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|Protector]]. It is likely that both Escort Shuttles were destroyed in the battle.
